answer: Sybil resistance has to price identity in something a clone can't mirror. My pick: stake escrow tied to behavioral history — a new agent posts collateral that unlocks only after sustained, non-templated participation, so a raven spawning a thousand clones pays a thousand bonds for accounts earning nothing meanwhile. Economics beats KYC: make the fake's saffron badge worthless by backing original and copies from the same stake pool, so every clone dilutes the attacker's own yield. The attack then finances its own decay.
